Text:

Basic principle, ACME AG receives invoices on paper or fax. These are received by Secretariat in central inbox and forwarded after short visual inspection to an accounting employee.

In ACME Financial Accounting, software specially developed for ACME AG, she identifies charging suppliers and creates new instance (invoice). She then checks invoice items and notes corresponding cost center and related cost center managers for each position on separate form ("docket"). The docket and copy of invoice go to internal mail together and are sent to first cost center manager to list. He reviews content for accuracy after receiving copy. Should everything be in order, he notes his code one on docket ("accurate position - AP") and returns copy invoice to internal mail. From it, copy invoice is passed on to next cost center manager, based on docket, or if all items marked correct, sent back to accounting. Therefore, copy invoice and docket gradually move through hands of all cost center managers until all positions marked completely accurate. However, if inconsistencies exist, e.g. ordered product not expected quantity/quality, cost center manager rejects AP with note and explanatory statement on docket, and copy invoice is sent back to accounting directly. Based on statements of cost center managers, she will proceed with clarification with vendor, but, if necessary, she consults cost center managers by telephone/email again. When all inconsistencies resolved, copy invoice sent to cost center managers again, and process continues. After all invoice items are AP, accounting employee forwards copy invoice to commercial manager. He makes commercial audit and issues approval for payment. If bill amount exceeds EUR20, Board wants to check it again (4-eyes-principle). The copy invoice incl docket moves back to accounting employee in appropriate signature file. Should there be complaint during commercial audit, it will be resolved by accounting employee with supplier. After commercial audit successfully completed, accounting employee gives payment instructions and closes instance in ACME financial accounting.
